 Antonio Nusa and (who else?) Erling Haaland put Wales to the sword in Oslo

 17m ago 14.16 EST So where does this leave Wales ? On the brink, is where.
 1. Portugal P4 W 4 D0 L0 GD+5 Pts 12
2. Norway P5 W2 D0 L3 GD0 Pts 6
3. Denmark P4 W2 D0 L2 GD0 Pts 6
4. Wales P5 W1 D0 L4 GD-5 Pts 3 
 Even if Wales beat Portugal in Cardiff next week, they cannot finish above either Norway or Denmark, as they have lost the head-to-heads with both countries. They’re now guaranteed to finish bottom of A4. However, that doesn’t mean relegation has been confirmed. If they end the campaign as one of the two best-ranked fourth-placed sides, they’ll go into a two-legged relegation play-off with one of the League B runners-up, and yes this is a whole load of Byzantine nonsense. Currently that ranking looks like this …
 1. Wales (A4) P5 GD-5 Pts 3
2. Serbia (A2) P5 GD-7 Pts 0
3. Turkey (A1) P5 GD-10 Pts 0
4. Czechia (A3) P5 GD-10 Pts 0 
 … so a wild week stretches out ahead of Wales one way or another. Thanks for reading this MBM.
 Clinical Norway dent Wales’ Nations League top-tier hopes with victory in Oslo Read more Share Updated at  14.31 EST 29m ago 14.04 EST An extremely disappointed Ben Davies talks to the BBC. “It’s one of them … a sloppy first goal … after all the good work we put in … it feels tough … one of those nights … we could have been a bit more clinical … we’re playing against a team who got to the quarter-finals of the World Cup … we gave them a good run … it’s another step but a tough result to take … we have nothing to lose [against Portugal] … we’ll go into that hoping to get a good result and put a good performance in.”
 Share 31m ago 14.01 EST Wales were arguably the better side in the first half – Dan James had three decent if not exactly gilt-edged chances – but Norway had too much attacking quality in the second. Antonio Nusa took a ball down gymnastically from the heavens to win a corner, then scored a fine goal from it; he was involved in the slick build-up to Andreas Schjelderup’s second; he sent Ethan Ampadu and Connor Roberts off to the shop for the Aftenposten and 20 Bensons with an outrageous bit of skill that nearly led to another goal. David Brooks scored a fine one himself, but any hopes of an unlikely comeback were nixed when Ben Davies gifted possession to Erling Haaland, who set off a chain of events that led to a penalty he scored himself. Haaland has now scored 66 goals in 60 matches for Norway. We’ll just leave that statement hanging there.
 Share Updated at  14.06 EST 38m ago 13.55 EST FULL TIME: Norway 3-1 Wales
 … but also Wales 35-28 New Zealand , so it’s swings and roundabouts.
 Share Updated at  14.23 EST 38m ago 13.54 EST 90 min +5: Wales fans are entitled to demur, but it’s such a shame Nusa didn’t finish that off. What a shimmy and shake to see off two players in the tightest of spots. It would have been an all-timer. Having said that, 4-1 would have been cruel on Wales.
 Share 40m ago 13.53 EST 90 min +3: Nusa slaloms past a couple of defenders, wriggling through a tight spot inside the Welsh box on the left. Roberts and Ampadu completely flummoxed. He opens his body and looks for the bottom right, but Darlow parries well. The ball breaks to Haaland at the far stick, but Davies blocks what looks a certain goal. Wow. That was sensational from Nusa!
 Share 42m ago 13.51 EST 90 min +2: Østigård and Myhre come on for Møller Wolfe and the captain Ødegaard.
 Share 43m ago 13.50 EST 90 min +1: Haaland scaampers down the left. He’s clear. He should score, but in trying to sidefoot past Darlow at his near post, hits the outside of that upright and out for a goal kick. The flag goes up for offside, but it was super-tight and VAR might have overturned that decision … so that goes down as a big miss.
 Share 44m ago 13.49 EST 90 min: There will be six additional minutes. Remember what Manchester United did to Aston Villa with that exact amount of added time last weekend? Well, that.
 Share 45m ago 13.47 EST 89 min: Johnson responds by juggling the ball at speed down the left, and thrashing a shot into the side netting. Selvik might have got a micro-touch to that, but Wales aren’t getting the corner.
 Share 46m ago 13.46 EST GOAL! Norway 3-1 Wales (Haaland 88 pen)
 Haaland, unflaapable, stutters his run-up and whips into the bottom right, having sent Darlow the wrong way. Game over.
 View image in fullscreen Norway's Erling Haaland steps up … Photograph: Fredrik Varfjell/NTB Scanpix/AP View image in fullscreen And sends the keeper the wrong way and tucks the ball home from the penalty spot to extend Norway’s lead. Photograph: Nick Potts/PA View image in fullscreen Which he’s happy about. Photograph: Fredrik Varfjell/EPA Share Updated at  13.56 EST 47m ago 13.45 EST 87 min: Haaland waits patiently on the spot, ball in hand, as Wilson is booked for encroaching and then arguing about it.
 Share 48m ago 13.45 EST Penalty for Norway!
 86 min: The ball comes straight back at Wales down the middle. Davies carelessly cushions a header straight to Haaland, who rolls it forward for Schjelderup. Roberts challenges from behind, and clips him. An obvious spot kick, and a booking for Roberts as well.
 Share 50m ago 13.43 EST 85 min: Before the corner can be taken, Ryerson is replaced by Pedersen. Then Rodon heads Schjelderup’s delivery clear. However …
 Share 50m ago 13.42 EST 84 min: This is much better from Odegaard, who takes a touch in from the right to make room for a shot. He curls it towards the bottom left, and Darlow has to extend fully to fingertip around the post. That’s great play all round.
 Share 51m ago 13.41 EST 83 min: Odegaard strides down the right. He’s got three team-mates in the Wales box, but hoicks a dismal cross behind all of them.
 Share 53m ago 13.40 EST 81 min: It’s the Wales fans you can hear now, and Wilson and Brooks nearly open up Norway again with a crisp interchange down the inside-right channel. Nusa drops back to put a stop to it, but Wales are up for this. Norway can’t get out!
 Share 55m ago 13.38 EST GOAL! Norway 2-1 Wales (Brooks 79)
 Wilson dinks a pass down the inside-right channel for Brooks, who holds off Møller Wolfe, barges into the box, and dinks a delicate shot over Selvik and into the bottom right! Game on, and the Norway fans may have gone a little early with that Viking row.
 View image in fullscreen David Brooks (centre) dinks the ball into the net to get Wales back in the game. Photograph: Nick Potts/PA Share Updated at  13.45 EST 1h ago 13.37 EST 78 min: Colwill latches onto a loose ball on the edge of the Norway D. He should do better than smack his shot straight at Selvik. But never mind, because …
 Share 1h ago 13.36 EST 77 min: Nothing comes of the corner, and so the crowd, giddy with relief, launch into their first Viking row of the night.
 Share 1h ago 13.35 EST 76 min: … and Wales nearly score it, Ampadu latching onto a Møller Wolfe half-clearance, aiming a stunning rising drive towards the top-left corner from the edge of the box. Selvik tips onto the top of his crossbar and out for a corner. Some shot, with a save to match it.
 Share 1h ago 13.33 EST 75 min: Some pinball in the Norway box. The ball drops to Roberts, who belts a cross from a very tight position on the left. Selvik handles well at his near post. Norway counter, Schjelderup’s shot from the edge of the D blocked. There’s another goal in this game, somewhere.
 Share 1h ago 13.32 EST 74 min: Berg crosses from the right. The ball’s only half cleared … so Wales are lucky that Moller Wolfe accidentally stands on it. That was a big opportunity to shoot under very little pressure.
 Share 1h ago 13.30 EST 72 min: … and that’s part of a triple change, with Brooks and Roberts also coming on. Cullen and James make way.
 Share 1h ago 13.29 EST 71 min: Colwill replaces the stricken Williams …
 Share 1h ago 13.29 EST 70 min: Williams pearls a speculative shot towards the bottom right. It’s no good, then he pulls up. It’s all suddenly unravelling for Wales .
 Share 1h ago 13.28 EST 69 min: Well, that was a significantly better first touch by Schjelderup than his hapless fellow sub Berg.
 Share 1h ago 13.27 EST GOAL! Norway 2-0 Wales (Schjelderup 68)
 This is a simple but beautiful goal. A ball’s shovelled down the left flank by Odegaard. Nusa reaches it and touches it infield. Haaland would be within his rights to shoot, but shuttles it further across for Schjelderup, who can’t miss from six yards. Into the bottom corner it goes. What a move.
 View image in fullscreen Andreas Schjelderup wheels away in celebration after tucking the ball away. Photograph: Fredrik Varfjell/EPA Share Updated at  13.44 EST 1h ago 13.25 EST 67 min: Berg’s first touch is a slapstick masterpiece, as he kicks the ball up against his own startled face and out for a goal kick.
 Share 1h ago 13.24 EST 66 min: Norway make a double change. On come Schjelderup and Berg at the expense of Bobb and Aasgaard. When play restarts, Moller Wolfe crosses from the left for Haaland, but Dasilva does enough to put his man off.
 Share 1h ago 13.23 EST 65 min: Harris is immediately in the thick of it, spinning Heggem to the right of the Norway D and threading a shot towards the bottom right. Accurate, but not particularly powerful, and it’s easy for Selvik.
 Share 1h ago 13.22 EST 64 min: Wales replace the ineffective Koumas with Harris.
 Share 1h ago 13.21 EST 63 min: Nusa is a magnificent talent, though. But then we saw that at the World Cup , so it’s hardly breaking news.
 Share 1h ago 13.20 EST 61 min: The Ullevaal had fallen a little quiet before that goal. It’s not quiet now. Inspired, Aasgaard throws himself into a couple of 50-50s down the left, and nearly forces the ball forward for Nusa. Had he managed to complete his task, Nusa was away. The hosts have their tails up.
 Share 1h ago 13.18 EST GOAL! Norway 1-0 Wales (Nusa 59)
 The corner’s only half-cleared. The ball drops to Nusa on the edge of the box, to the left of the D. He takes a touch infield, sweeping James aside, before fizzling a low drive into the bottom left. Darlow has no chance. What a strike … and it would never have happened without that acrobatic trap a minute earlier.
 View image in fullscreen Norway's Antonio Nusa (second right) fires home to open the scoring. Photograph: Nick Potts/PA View image in fullscreen Nusa (second left) wheels away in celebration … Photograph: Nick Potts/PA View image in fullscreen Then celebrates with a knee slide. Photograph: Mateusz Słodkowski/Getty Images Share Updated at  13.32 EST 1h ago 13.17 EST 58 min: Nusa takes down a difficult crossfield pass with an elegant leap and trap, then dribbles hard down the left, winning a corner off Williams, from which …
 Share 1h ago 13.16 EST 56 min: Rodon skittles Berge. Ryerson thinks a free kick is going to be awarded, so puts his hand on the ball then takes one. But the ref hasn’t whistled! Wales want a free kick of their own, but they don’t get that either. Norway are rewarded the restart. Some mild Welsh seething, but it’s all in the middle of the park so nothing much has been lost. A mildly amusing aside.
 Share 1h ago 13.13 EST 54 min: Bobb skates past Dasilva on the right. He reaches the byline but his cross pings off Davies and out for a corner, which is worked right to left. Nusa swans in from the flank and releases Berge into the box with a clever reverse pass down the channel. Berge opens his body and aims for the far corner, only for Cullen to make a last-ditch block. That almost certainly saved a goal. Norway are getting closer.
 Share 1h ago 13.11 EST 52 min: Nusa spins Ampadu with absurd ease down the left. Ampadu throws his hands around the winger’s waist from behind, but suddenly remembers he’s already been booked and releases. Just in time, because had Nusa gone down, Ampadu would surely have been walking. Nothing comes of the rest of the attack.
 Share 1h ago 13.08 EST 50 min: Norway knock it around the back awhile. All very patient, but Wales won’t mind this.
 Share 1h ago 13.06 EST 48 min: … the corner’s worked back to Dasilva, who threads a pass down the inside-right channel for Johnson, who swivels and lashes a first-time shot into the side netting. Selvik had it covered.
 Share 1h ago 13.06 EST 47 min: James was the liveliest Welsh attacker in the first half, and he starts the second in similar mood, dribbling down the right and winning a corner, from which …
 Share 1h ago 13.04 EST Norway get the second half underway. No changes.
 Share 2h ago 12.53 EST Half-time entertainment. The other game in Group A4, between Portugal and Denmark, will be played later this evening. Our first glimpse of a future without him . Miguel Dantas reports from Portugal.
 Portugal did the extraordinary with Cristiano Ronaldo. Can they do it without him? Read more Share 2h ago 12.48 EST HALF TIME: Norway 0-0 Wales
 Both teams have had their half-chances. Dan James with three of them. But nothing clear cut. Wales will be the happier, having defended resolutely.
 Share 2h ago 12.47 EST 45 min: Nusa rolls a pass down the left for Aasgaard, who crosses low, hoping to find Haaland in the middle for a tap-in. Rodon pokes out for a corner, from which Cullen draws a foul from Haaland. There will be one additional first-half minute.
 Share 2h ago 12.44 EST 43 min: Wilson slips James into the Norway box down the right. James pearls a shot from a tight angle. Selvik parries, and the rebound fails to fall to either Koumas or Cullen. Norway clear their lines. James has had his chances.
 Share 2h ago 12.43 EST 42 min: I wanted to use the word “bobble” for that coming-together between Davies and Bobb, but after using “weaves” it felt like putting a hat on a hat. Anyway, fine run and a defensive intervention to match.
 Share 2h ago 12.42 EST 40 min: Bobb weaves past Johnson and Dasilva down the right but can’t beat a third man in Davies. A fine dribble, but the ball pings back off Davies, onto Bobb, and out. Goal kick.
 Share 2h ago 12.40 EST 39 min: … but his near-post delivery is awful, and Cullen clears. Wales counter quickly, the ball ending up with James on the left. He whips a cross through the six-yard box. Koumas is the only yellow shirt anywhere near, and he fails to respond. Had Koumas gambled and made a run, he’d have had a tap-in.
 Share 2h ago 12.39 EST 38 min: Bobb plays a speculative ball down the right, forcing Ampadu to extend a leg and poke out for another Norway corner. Odegaard wanders over to take …
 Share 2h ago 12.38 EST 37 min: Heggem swings a cross in from the left. Under pressure from Haaland, Darlow races off his line to punch clear with authority. Odegaard tries again from the right. Haaland wins a header this time, but can’t get any power on it, or direct it goalwards. Haaland sighs.
 Share 2h ago 12.37 EST 35 min: Nusa looks a wee bit frustrated. He’s looked lively, but the final pass hasn’t come off for him. Odegaard frowning too. Craig Bellamy will be delighted to see this mild Norwegian displeasure.
 Share 2h ago 12.34 EST 33 min: Norway pin Wales back. Nusa, Odegaard and Bobb buzzing around. Wales defensively disciplined. It suddenly feels like the last 28 minutes of the rugby.
 Share 2h ago 12.32 EST 31 min: Haaland hasn’t done anything so far. But then! He holds the ball up on the edge of the Welsh box, holding off three defenders with absurd ease, and lays off to Aasgaard, whose low shot is deflected wide right. Corner, which Odegaard one-twos with Bobb, the latter releasing his mate along the byline with a cute backflick. But the flag goes up for offside. Shame, because it was a clever move.
 Share 2h ago 12.30 EST 29 min: Arsenal fans need not worry. Odegaard is fine, and he uses that now slightly flattened foot to stroke a lovely crossfield pass to Nusa on the left. Nusa cuts back infield and blazes over the bar. Wales are keeping Norway at arm’s length for the most part.
 Share 2h ago 12.29 EST 28 min: Cullen stands on Odegaard’s foot, and is fortunate to escape a booking. A slight slip, so the referee is kind. Odegaard goes down awhile, but gets back up eventually.
